blurb:
There’s nothing more magical than downtown Chicago during the holidays. Bobby’s Bike Hike & Food Tours—internationally recognized for quality—presents the Holiday Hike, a 3-hour guided walking and food tour of the city’s top seasonal attractions.

You’ll sample Chicago favorites like deep-dish pizza, a Chicago-style hot dog, Italian beef, a chocolate brownie, and hot apple cider. Alcoholic beverages aren’t included, but holiday drink pairings can be added on-site.

Our local guides will fill the tour with festive stories—like how Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer originated in Chicago. You’ll see the classic holiday windows at the original Marshall Field’s, the Chicago Christmas tree, the Millennium Park ice rink, and enjoy VIP entry to the Christkindlmarket.

No other tour offers such a complete Chicago holiday experience!
